title: Angela M.W. Kelley to join Associated Bank as General Counsel
summary: Associated Banc-Corp (NYSE: ASB) ("Associated") today announced that Angela M.W. Kelley, 45, will succeed Randall J. Erickson, 67, who is retiring as executive vice president, general counsel and corporate secretary effective October 13, 2026. Erickson will remain in an advisory capacity through the end of 2026 to ensure a successful transition of his duties.
